name: iteration03-safearea-destruction
description: Verify safe-area geometry, touch targets, mission-control banners, Armory separation, depth-block focus, bounded collapse physics, explicit world reconstruction, and responsive boss HUD.

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local function verifyBothFaceText(part,title)
 assert(part and part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Transparency<1,'text sign missing or hidden')
 for _,face in ipairs({Enum.NormalId.Front,Enum.NormalId.Back}) do
  local found=false
  for _,surface in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
   if surface:IsA('SurfaceGui') and surface.Face==face and surface.Enabled then
    for _,label in ipairs(surface:GetDescendants()) do if label:IsA('TextLabel') and label.Visible and label.TextTransparency<1 and string.find(string.upper(label.Text),string.upper(title),1,true) then found=true end end
   end
  end
  assert(found,'visible sign text missing on '..tostring(face)..': '..title)
 end
 return true
end
local function verifyPremiumDisplays(root,G)
 local city=root.Polish['City Decor'] local count=0 local tiers={}
 assert(#G.PremiumFists>0,'empty premium catalog')
 for _,item in ipairs(G.PremiumFists) do
  local stand=assert(root.Interactables:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Stand'),'configured stand missing '..item.name)
  assert(stand:IsA('BasePart') and stand.Anchored and stand.CanQuery and stand:GetAttribute('PremiumOnly')==true,'stand is not an actual premium interaction')
  local display=assert(city:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Creator Store Display'),'showcase missing '..item.name)
  local visible=0 for _,d in ipairs(display:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') and d.Transparency<1 then visible+=1 end end
  assert(visible>0 and display:GetAttribute('VisualRole')=='PremiumFistShowcase' and display:GetAttribute('PremiumTier')==item.tier,'showcase geometry/tier missing')
  verifyBothFaceText(city:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Armory Nameplate'),item.displayName or item.name)
  assert(not tiers[item.tier],'duplicate premium tier') tiers[item.tier]=true count+=1
 end
 return count
end

local count=verifyPremiumDisplays(root,G) local block=root['Depth Blocks'].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02 local minimum=math.huge for _,item in ipairs(G.PremiumFists) do local stand=root.Interactables[item.name..' Stand'] minimum=math.min(minimum,(stand.Position-block.Position).Magnitude) end
assert(minimum>12 and #root['Depth Blocks']:GetChildren()==5400 and root:GetAttribute('MaxDepthPhysicsFragments')==120,'Armory/depth separation or debris budget incorrect') return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,stands=count,minSeparation=minimum,depthBlocks=5400,debrisCap=120})

steps.label: configured premium Armory stands are outside shared depth structure

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
local function assertContained(container,object)
 assert(object and object:IsA('GuiObject') and object.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and object.AbsoluteSize.Y>0,'missing rendered rectangle')
 local a,b=container.AbsolutePosition,container.AbsoluteSize local p,s=object.AbsolutePosition,object.AbsoluteSize
 assert(p.X>=a.X-1 and p.Y>=a.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=a.X+b.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=a.Y+b.Y+1,'rendered bounds outside safe host: '..object.Name)
end
local function effectivelyVisible(object)
 local node=object while node do if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end node=node.Parent end return true
end
assert(g.ScreenInsets==Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets and g.SafeAreaCompatibility==Enum.SafeAreaCompatibility.None,'safe insets incorrect')
a:Invoke('CloseMenus') task.wait(.2) local safe=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD assert(effectivelyVisible(safe),'actual HUD hidden')
for _,name in ipairs({'PowerCard','CoinsCard','WallCard'}) do local card=safe[name] assert(effectivelyVisible(card),'HUD card invisible') assertContained(safe,card) end
local targets=0 for _,tab in ipairs({'Tasks','Settings'}) do a:Invoke('OpenTab',tab) task.wait(.3) local host=tab=='Settings' and g.SettingsWindow or g.GameMenu assert(effectivelyVisible(host),'modal not visible') assertContained(safe,host)
 local count=0 for _,d in ipairs(host:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('TextButton') and effectivelyVisible(d) then assert(d.AbsoluteSize.Y>=43.5,'touch target below 44px '..d.Name) count+=1 end end assert(count>0,'modal has no real buttons') targets+=count end
a:Invoke('CloseMenus') return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,actualModalTargets=targets,safeArea=true})

steps.label: actual HUD and standalone Settings fit safe area with touch targets

local H=game:GetService("HttpService")
local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
c:Invoke("SetStats",{Power=120,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0})
local r=c:Invoke("BreakWall","Brick Wall",1)
local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local w=root["Depth Blocks"].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02 local debris=root["Depth Physics Debris"] local chunks=0 local frontSafe=true
for _,d in ipairs(debris:GetChildren()) do if string.find(d.Name,w.Name,1,true)==1 then chunks+=1 if (d:GetAttribute("InitialForwardSpeed") or 0)<=0 or (d:GetAttribute("SpawnFrontOffset") or 0)<=0 then frontSafe=false end end end
return H:JSONEncode({ok=r.ok,broken=w:GetAttribute("Broken"),hp=w:GetAttribute("HP"),hidden=w.Transparency==1 and not w.CanCollide and not w.CanQuery,chunks=chunks,frontSafe=frontSafe,withinBudget=#debris:GetChildren()<=120})
